title: should render the alert count badge in the Used by cell for a used destination
verifies: a destination referenced by 3 alerts shows an alert count badge of 3 and no Unused chip

title: should open the impact dialog and list the destination's downstream alerts without disagreement
verifies: the impact dialog subtitle and alerts lane agree with the Used by cell count (3 alerts)

title: should show the Unused chip and a No consumers dialog for an orphan destination
verifies: an orphan destination shows the Unused chip and a No consumers dialog

title: should surface the 409 in-use error when deleting a destination referenced by alerts
verifies: deleting an in-use destination shows the 'is used by' error toast and the row remains

title: should decrement the Used by count when an alert is deleted from the impact dialog
verifies: deleting one alert from the impact dialog decrements the Used by count from 2 to 1 without a page reload
